status: model of the fetch Worker built from subnet/detect-fetch (slop-ninja-detect-fetch-testnet), a stateless Worker with no Durable Object class. The JS reserve, glue costs and stack are the coordinator model's inputs (the same workers-rs 0.8.7, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions, the same hand-written export pattern), not measured on this Worker yet, so the build uses the arena's unmeasured-model feature together with observe (migration step 1) and links growable linear memory under the ceiling below. The body-dependent work (a robots.txt parse, or the strip pass, the DOM and the extraction of one page) is reserved from the isolate's fetch memory (routes::FETCH_MEMORY_BYTES) by its measured footprint (bound.rs: EXTRACT_BYTES_PER_HTML_BYTE, BYTES_PER_ELEMENT, ROBOTS_WORK_BYTES, STATICS_HOME_BYTES, each checked by the native arena witnesses in arena_witness.rs on the pinned lol_html 3.0.3 and dom_smoothie 0.19.0); the route footprints below are the fixed parts.
page_bytes_source: WebAssembly page size, equal to the dlmalloc 0.2.12 system granularity
isolate_bytes_source: Cloudflare Workers limits: "128 MB per isolate", read as 10^6 bytes, the smaller of the two readings
js_reserve_bytes_source: the coordinator model's value (a linear memory ceiling of 1,536 pages), kept so the models share one unmeasured JS reserve until this Worker's is measured through the inspector
js_envelope_bytes_source: not measured: the largest body this Worker holds in JS before admitting it into linear memory is one chunk of a fetched body (the body reader holds one chunk at a time and copies it a page-sized window at a time), rounded up to one page of headroom
glue_static_bytes_source: the workers-rs 0.8.7 glue probe (subnet/crates/arena/glue-probe/memory-model.json, local workerd 2026-10-23, round2 run probe1): idle glue 872 B (hand-written exports), rounded up to the next power of two as the stated margin; this crate's lockfile pins the same worker, wasm-bindgen and js-sys versions. The extraction stack's lazy statics live in their own home scope (routes::STATICS_HOME_BYTES), not in the glue partition
glue_ticket_bytes_source: the glue probe's largest measured glue per entry with every export hand-written, one ticket per entry: 304 B (waitUntil continuation), rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker's hand-written fetch export (cf.rs) follows the probe's admitted pattern
glue_resident_bytes_source: the glue probe: 24 B per co-resident Durable Object instance, rounded up to the next power of two; this Worker defines no Durable Object class, so no resident is admitted
min_route_bytes_source: the smallest route control footprint: the 404 route's (routes::OTHER_CONTROL_BYTES, one page), checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table
largest_route_bytes_source: the fetch route's control footprint (routes::FETCH_CONTROL_BYTES) plus the scope's state page; checked by routes::tests::the_model_matches_the_route_table. The body-dependent part of a fetch or robots read is reserved from the fetch memory, not from this footprint
stack_bytes_source: rustc wasm32-unknown-unknown links the stack first with rust-lld's default -z stack-size=1048576 (scratch probe, 2026-10-31); the pool starts above static data, so the stack is outside every arena. The extractor's recursion is bounded by bound::DEPTH_BOUND (measured natively on a 1 MiB thread stack, a bound for wasm32's smaller frames)
stack_high_water_bytes_source: not measured on this build: the glue probe's 3,912 B (every workers-rs entry kind), a lower bound
